feature_contract.goal: Prevent R32 host final asynchronous DirectGPU consumption ACK queries and published slot acknowledgments from surviving a D3D11 device or immediate-context replacement within one OpenXR session, while retaining ordinary zero-wait presentation.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Final OpenXR host R32 EVENT/ACK owner only, separate from existing SafeEye source device-cache ownership; no D3D9 producer, world/HUD, SkyGlow, FFB, DX11 or DXVK changes.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: The final R32 direct-submit owner previously released EVENT queries only on xrDestroySession and keyed cached acknowledgments by producer generation/PID; host D3D11 device/context can rebind without ending the XR session, making old GetData/End calls unsafe. Existing 00829 fixed SafeEye resource ownership in a DIFFERENT R32 host cache, not this final submission ACK owner.
trace_stages: D3D9Ex producer presents its frame to the shared DirectGPU ring with slot, frame, transport generation, run generation and PID.
Host R32 final OpenXR projection samples producer textures and issues D3D11 EVENT through its current immediate context before asynchronous ACK.

After host device/context Reset, old completion queries must be forgotten without publishing old ACKs; new final projection uses new device-bound EVENT while other eye/source fallbacks remain unchanged.
subcomponents: Keep AddRef/Release paired strong ownership of active host device and immediate context at the final async ACK layer, dropping old pending queries/ACK caches on either pointer transition.
Fence both EndFrame completion polling and ArmConsumptionFence same-frame/ACK reuse behind rebind synchronization, including null-owner SafeEye fallback.
Compile and execute a real no-HMD C++ host owner-epoch smoke on exact GitHub Actions SHA with positive, null, independent device/context replacement and idempotent-stable cases.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Old D3D11 EVENT queries and pending ACKs never cross a changed host device or immediate-context identity and the next projection can arm a new owner.
Null devices/contexts reject fast-submit; stable identity does not erase a valid pending fence; teardown releases strong COM references and preserves existing fallback.
Final exact-SHA DX9Ex Active full x64 host/x86 game/package and smoke plus Domain Isolation and Full Source Impact gates succeed.

diagnosis.original_evidence: R32 direct-submit Pending per-slot D3D11Query and AckedFrame cache were reset by DestroySession only; neither EndFrame polling nor same-frame ArmConsumptionFence guarded current host D3D11 device/context epoch.
source_trace: Game D3D9Ex ring frame and generation publication
Host R32 EVENT GetData and ArmConsumptionFence from OutRunVrFinalTest::Context
OpenXR EndFrame projects eyes then publishes producer ACK when queued D3D11 sampling completes
diagnosis.root_cause: The final R32 host async ACK fence owner assumed one device/context for the lifetime of an OpenXR session and could poll or rearm an old-device EVENT after host graphics reinitialization.
alternatives_rejected: Existing R32 SafeEye device epoch covers its own opened shared textures, but not the separate final-submit Pending[] EVENT query pool.
Resetting ACK state only on XR DestroySession misses same-session host D3D11 device/context recovery.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: AddRef-pinned device/context identity is reconciled before EndFrame Poll and ArmConsumptionFence; transitions release old queries without ACK publication and null owners force the established fallback.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: New native C++ epoch-policy smoke covers device-only, context-only, pair changes, null, stable and rebind behavior.

runtime_note: RUNTIME_VALIDATION=UNTESTED: no Quest3/VDXR gameplay or host D3D11 runtime swap hardware validation. Static/pure C++ and Win32 compile cannot prove HMD correctness.
